info.name: School_ERP - Admission Service (Module 02)
info.description:
All admissionservice APIs, one folder per user story (US-02001, US-02002, US-02003, US-02004, US-02005, US-02006, US-02007, US-02008, US-02009, US-02010).

Setup: run admissionservice (default http://localhost:8083/admissionservice) and fill the *Token variables with JWTs issued by authservice for the listed roles. Running the folders in order walks one candidate through the pipeline: US-02001 captures {{enquiryId}}, and later positive requests capture examId, evaluationId, documentId, offerId, receiptNumber, studentId and meritListId. Some steps need data in a particular state first (for example verified documents before conversion); see each folder's wiki page.
Side effects: positive POST/PATCH requests create or change data.
